realtime_dispatch.stale_arrival: HOLD both robots on every stale image; separate 3 SIM-s continuous stale carry budget; no visual failure relabeling.
realtime_dispatch.beam_segmentation: Exact 18-threshold candidates cached for four JPEGs, copied per tracker; independent temporal selection unchanged.
realtime_dispatch.launcher: ordinary Python physics owner; only isolated macOS observer runs mjpython

realtime_dispatch.carry_lease_scope: Moving open RGB carry commands renew for at most .25s and no later than observed_at_s+.6; next capture starts after .02s. Zero/HOLD and DONE retain policy duration.
realtime_dispatch.shaft_geometry: Exact grouped axial slices and contour bounding-box mask with original pixel coordinates restored before PCA. Thresholds, candidate ordering and independent tracking unchanged.
realtime_dispatch.solo_lease_scope: Direct nonzero carry/yield .25s renewals within original RGB+.6 TTL; capture after .02s; zero/HOLD and calibrated pose/macro intervals retained.
realtime_dispatch.resource_commit: Worker permission snapshot only; owner checks freshness and revalidates all gate requests before committing candidate and live locks.
realtime_dispatch.shaft_contrast: Original 150..190 saturation consensus first; on failure require same centerline gates and 4 cuts/15 span at 105..130 plus at least one agreeing high-cut fit from current RGB.
realtime_dispatch.carry_prefetch: Owner requests at most one next batch during sequential current analysis; actual capture happens at render readiness. Original .6 TTL and .25 max lease, cancellation/drain preserved.
realtime_dispatch.waiting_observations: Fresh denied-unload observations may update only strictly passed own-RGB carry guard state. Route index, locks, mission steps and absolute anchor unchanged; failed checks and stale frames never reset the guard.
realtime_dispatch.solo_budget: 300 active SIM-s; owner-confirmed denied resource intervals counted separately as resource_wait, total=active+resource_wait. Stale RGB/backpressure charge active; whole-run wall deadline unchanged.
realtime_dispatch.solo_moving_cadence: Prefetch RGB after .02s; accept consecutive moving carry decisions no faster than prior action duration .2s, capped by its original TTL lease. Stop, stale, denied and phase transition bypass cadence; budgets unchanged.
realtime_dispatch.pending_pair_renewal: Exact last accepted CRUISE command may renew only before its current lease expires, within the same original RGB+.6 deadline and per-command .25 cap; owner rechecks plan, paired GO reports and resource permissions. Frozen accepted RGB beam feature only; no new decision or timestamp fabricated.
realtime_dispatch.pair_perception: Open realtime carry pure RGB binding/independent route tracking/own payload/skew run in one persistent spawn CPU process. Exact original JPEGs and detached RGB/static state only; owner verifies frame/time/source SHA and records accepted output. No world, live permission or actuator in child; no runtime fallback. Original TTL and leases unchanged.
realtime_dispatch.pair_perception_lifecycle: Owner HOLD then pumps physics during child ready handshake before first carry snapshot; single ordered pending batch, 10 wall-second watchdog, bounded join/terminate/kill on cleanup. IPC runs off owner.
realtime_dispatch.pair_perception_timing: pair_bind for spawn_cpu means child tracking/canonicalization only, excluding IPC/owner file write. Compare original observation-to-decision age and whole mission wall time for performance.
realtime_dispatch.pair_top_pipeline: Open realtime carry only: one coherent snapshot publishes copied TOP via callback-free latch while same-slot own views continue rendering. Dedicated TOP JPEG worker encodes/records once, spawn child starts pure TOP tracking/canonicalization/route/skew; full own views reuse that exact TOP and finish own-payload analysis. Owner verifies same frame/time/TOP bytes/hash and commits once after all views complete. Existing full batch API unchanged.
realtime_dispatch.pair_top_lifetime: Slot released only when full render succeeds/fails/cancels; partial TOP never grants motor permission. Later own/render/analysis failure holds pair and aborts ordered child; no fallback or next-frame continuation. One speculative snapshot, one ordered child frame with TOP then own phase.
realtime_dispatch.pair_top_timing: Output-only absolute TOP-render/materialization, child analysis start/end, full-render/own-materialization timestamps and measured overlap; retain original observed_at_s for .6 TTL and .25 max command. Small real-render/gated tests verify pixel identity and early publication; full native timing is separate evidence.
realtime_dispatch.pending_solo_renewal: Owner may renew exact last accepted moving carry command only before its live lease expires, within original RGB observed_at_s+.6 and .25 max lease. Current plan, TRANSIT and prior route resource permissions required. Fresh stop/denial/stale/error/phase exit cancels renewal. Original .2 decision cadence and budgets unchanged; receipts do not count as decisions.
realtime_dispatch.box_cruise: Only known independent open-map box pre-final waypoints: forward cap .12 and lateral cap .10, reverse .05; existing .002 gain, .025 minimum, .2 duration and near/final containment unchanged. No terrain or interior obstacles.
realtime_dispatch.coarse_fine_handoff: Separate realtime unmodified-open admission using finite close RGB wheel-centroid/beam/reference gap (80..700 selected wheel pixels) and six unchanged fine-support models, then new stopped RGB rechecks both. The four-corner coarse heading may be unresolved only if the finer yaw models are supported; coarse motion remains zero/invalid. All other unresolved signatures fail closed. Seven fine stages, final precision and grasp checks remain.
realtime_dispatch.pending_coarse_renewal: Only standard open valid coarse APPROACH, owner pumps same approved moving command while next RGB pending, original observed+.6 deadline and .25 individual lease, no expired revival, rechecked plan/APPROACH permission and exact port issued state. Stop/stale/invalid/fine phase clears. 120-step and readiness gates unchanged.
realtime_dispatch.box_color_ambiguity: An already tracked box with multiple high-saturation candidates checks remaining existing saturation levels for a unique candidate within unchanged area/shape/8px prediction gates; unique stronger color remains preferred. Persistent ambiguity retains original bidirectional flow/HOLD gates.
realtime_dispatch.fine_pending_bridge: Standard open realtime supported visual-pose lateral/forward movement only, far from existing tolerance; bridge next RGB wait by at most .05 total SIM seconds beyond original issued expiry, also original capture+.6 TTL and individual .25 cap. No expired revival, yaw, near-ready, stationary confirmation, final refinement, dock or crossphase renewal. Same model commands and readiness.
realtime_dispatch.beam_cruise: Extend the existing open independent pre-final box cruise caps to beam: forward .12, lateral .10, reverse .05; original proportional gain, final .08 cap, waypoint readiness, shared GO/skew and exclusive unload gate unchanged. No terrain or interior obstacles.
realtime_dispatch.box_occlusion: Prior accepted cargo motion links orange robot foreground features; minimum 8 features and 60% agreement, 20x15px spread, current own RGB visual attachment and zero pan. At most 3 consecutive proxy frames, <1px or repeated frames rejected. No final delivery confirmation from proxy. Existing cargo 3-point/60% optical flow gates unchanged.
realtime_dispatch.act_realtime: Raw coherent own/TOP and original .6s TTL/.25 lease/.2 cadence. Two independent temporal ACT workers, each1 CPU thread, predict concurrently. Exact-input frozen CNN/JPEG LRU16 cache in eval/no-grad only. Require20ms headroom; no stale adoption. Owner-abort joins already started requests, logs known inputs and unconfirmed slots; owned clients cleaned even after late startup/timeout. Legacy non-temporal scheduling retained.
realtime_dispatch.solo_near_field_servo: Unmodified static open map realtime only: opt-in two distinct geometry-validated own RGB observations, confidence >=.75, nearfield x>=.18, absolute vertical error>=45px, at least1px improvement, target continuity<=.04m and prior issued-PWM state match permit24 PWM cap. Otherwise legacy8. No measured joint input, trajectory/settling/final approach/grasp changes. Proposed delta/target and gate evidence recorded.
realtime_dispatch.box_direct_reacquisition: Open realtime opt-in only after existing tracking fails: current unique strong foreground cyan with size/hue continuity, fresh same-capture own attachment/hash, two recent direct cyan observations and dt-bounded visual velocity corridor; proxy does not seed velocity, no invisible-center fallback, owner TTL unchanged. Clears stale carrier/confirmations.
realtime_dispatch.rolling_solo_approach: Default OFF --rolling-visual-servo, realtime open only. Distinct current own direct cyan and paired TOP hashes; frame/time/plan/permission audit. Capture next RGB during <=.25s issued motor window, original action horizon and observed+.6s unchanged. Expiry/revocation/stale/exception holds. At own-RGB range <=.22m plus .03m command-based reobserve buffer, hold and fresh image after .2s settled interval precede old final-entry macro; command integral is not measured displacement. Actual hold clips effective issued windows; original scheduled windows also logged. No arm/grasp/carry/release/physics changes.
